stage: modelled cockpit art: real textured 3D, styled after concepts/cockpit/cockpit-warm-ceramic-v1.png

gameplay_hooks.GaugeHousing/Needles/<Gauge>Needle: rotate about local +Z; pivot at dial centre
gameplay_hooks.GaugeLabels (tscn): Label3D per gauge on taped paper
gameplay_hooks.Dressing/Notes/TaskNote: blank paper at the game TaskNote transform; gameplay writes the text
gameplay_hooks.ScreenHousings/*: frames only; live screens render at layout.json anchors
gameplay_hooks.Controls: moved out of cockpit_art.glb into cockpit/art/controls/*.glb (see coordination/interfaces.md)
gameplay_hooks.NoteText/<Id> (Label3D): sticky-note wording; set .text at runtime. Ids: YouGotThis, ItsFine, Chaos, MopFloor, SameBrain, HeartSticky, SmallSteps, DoTheThing, TodoList, Polaroid
gameplay_hooks.NoteText/Today: notebook TODAY list: Page/List/Title.text; Page/List/Item0..5 (.visible, Text.text BBCode, Box/Tick.visible)

printed_from_concept: none: every prop is modelled and textured in Blender (paper.py, props.py)

proposed_game_changes.Camera3D: adaptive fit: aspect < 16:9 -> KEEP_WIDTH, fov 100.3; else KEEP_HEIGHT, fov 68
proposed_game_changes.Lighting/Environment: use cockpit_lighting.tscn instead of the greybox WorldEnvironment and lights
proposed_game_changes.status: screen + camera sent to gameplay session (ASSETS-001)

aspect_support: 16:9 reference; 16:10 and 4:3 show extra wall/desk (adaptive camera); 21:9 shows dressed sides
cc0: Kenney Food Kit tried for can/mug/donut; rejected (faceted low-poly clashes with the concept). No third-party models used.
